title: 19. Nintendo: The Switch 2 Edition w/ Ryan O'Connor (Crossroads Capital)
thesis: The episode argues that Nintendo stock is extraordinarily cheap and represents an attractive investment, particularly given global uncertainty and the company's ability to thrive. The speaker contends that profits are snowballing and growing exponentially over the next three to four years, driven by Nintendo's refusal to raise prices on its services while competitors have more than doubled theirs. Based on these factors, the speaker expects the equity to be at least 3X higher in three years, representing a worst-case embedded IRR of 20% plus.
